ic_name: DALI (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface, IEC 62386 via TI SLAA422A)
signaling_summary: DALI defines a low-voltage DC bus that carries the Manchester-encoded digital signal. The bus voltage is in the range 9.5 V..22.5 V (the TI SLAA422A report cites the range 11.5 V..22.5 V per the standard). The bus is current-limited to ≈ 250 mA. Receivers are polarity-insensitive so the installer can connect DA+/DA- either way. The signal itself is Manchester-encoded: idle = HIGH (passive); a logic '1' is a LOW-to-HIGH transition halfway through the bit cell; a logic '0' is a HIGH-to-LOW transition halfway through the bit cell. The half-bit time TE is 1/(2 × 1200) ≈ 416.67 μs, so the full bit time is ≈ 833.33 μs. The bus is normally driven open-collector by all transmitters with a shared pull-up so any transmitter that drives LOW wins (wired-AND on the inverted line). Galvanic isolation between bus and microcontroller is required for safety; SLAA422A Figure 2 shows two 4N137-class opto-isolators (one in each direction) between the DALI line and the MSP430 GPIOs.

bus_voltage.polarity: Receivers polarity-insensitive; DA+ and DA- can be swapped at installation.

bus_current.notes: Current limit imposed by the DALI bus power supply. Total per-bus current is the sum of all connected control-gear quiescent and command-time draw.

manchester_signaling.encoding: Bi-phase Manchester per Figure 1 of SLAA422A — logic '1' = LOW→HIGH mid-bit transition, logic '0' = HIGH→LOW mid-bit transition.
manchester_signaling.idle_state: HIGH (passive). The bus pull-up holds the line HIGH; transmitters pull LOW.
manchester_signaling.start_bit: Always '1' (LOW→HIGH mid-bit transition); marks the beginning of a forward or backward frame.
manchester_signaling.stop_field: Two stop bits = continuous HIGH for ≥ 2 × bit-time (≈ 1.67 ms).
manchester_signaling.polarity_insensitive_receiver: Optoisolator chain inverts as needed; firmware decodes both edge directions.

isolation.topology: Opto-isolators between DALI bus and MSP430 — TI report Figure 2 shows two 4N137/4N25-class optos (one DALI→MCU, one MCU→DALI), with current-limit resistor on the bus side and pull-up on the MCU side.
isolation.rationale: DALI bus is galvanically separated from luminaire mains; opto-isolation prevents bus-side faults from reaching the controller and meets isolation requirements per IEC 62386-101.

led_driver_analog_path.buck_regulator: TPS62260 (TPS62260DRV) — 600 mV reference, hysteretic PFM/PWM buck, EN pin gates the LED current.

led_string: RGB LEDs on the TPS62260LED-338 EVM. Each colour driven by an independent TPS62260 buck + PWM EN signal from the MSP430 Timer_A3.

absolute_max_ratings.DALI_bus_voltage_max_V: 22.5 V (continuous); transient ≥ 30 V withstand expected from receivers.
absolute_max_ratings.MSP430_VCC_V: Per MSP430 family datasheet (1.8..3.6 V for value-line).
